title: Aureline M5 supported-line correction-line closure gate
description: Canonical per-domain closure-gate record minted by the correction-train-archive and closure-gate lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Turns a gap in an active supported line's correction-train archive into a visible, machine-checkable gate that blocks correction-line closure until fixed, instead of a shiproom note or oral memory: it records the closure-gate scope the gap sits in — missing archive coverage (a shipped correction packet on the active line has no archive record with exact-build identity, corrective action class, public communication state, and rollback outcome), a broken exact-build join (an archive record cannot be joined to its exact build / release-line identity, bug IDs, defect-ledger entries, or release artifact graph), or an untraceable correction line (a support or procurement reader cannot trace a correction from an advisory or release note back to the archived evidence bundle without private shiproom materials). Names the gate scope, binds the resolved supported-line identity, the affected archive-record reference, the archived-versus-active-build reference, and the active gate reason so release, support, and procurement readers see missing coverage or a broken join on the active line and correction-line closure stays blocked until it is fixed. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's correction history by hand. Public-safe and internal-only variants share one canonical record identity; raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
